Agents and apps

Give your AI agents the context they need.

Pendo is the largest product context graph in the world. Pendo captures human and agent behavior in the context of your business, all connected and tracked from a product’s first use. You get the most complete picture of what’s happening inside your product, and the clarity to act on it.

Frequently asked questions

Yes. Pendo can generally be installed in an hour or less by adding a lightweight snippet to your application. Once installed, teams can start collecting product usage data, building segments, and understanding user behavior without needing a dedicated data science team. For more complex environments, Pendo can support implementation across multiple apps, user roles, and data sources.

More Info: Installation options for a direct web implementation of Pendo

+−

Pendo is the only platform that unifies product and agent analytics, user feedback, in-app guidance, and AI-powered predictions into a single source of truth for product experience. While other tools force you to stitch together multiple vendors—one for analytics, another for guides, a third for roadmapping—Pendo closes the loop: understand user behavior, capture sentiment, prioritize what to build, and drive adoption with targeted experiences, all from one platform.


This integrated approach means faster time-to-insight, better cross-functional alignment, and the ability to act on data without switching contexts. Organizations see faster ROI compared to alternatives, with implementations measured in weeks rather than quarters—whether you're a 50-person startup or a Fortune 500 enterprise with thousands of applications.

+−

The most impactful outcomes depend on your strategic priorities:


Accelerate product-led growth: Companies using Pendo improve trial-to-paid conversion rates by 25-40% by guiding users to activation moments faster. Reduce time-to-value for new customers, increase feature adoption, and turn your product into your best sales channel.


Reduce churn and expand revenue: Identify at-risk accounts 3-6 months before renewal using Pendo Predict's AI models, then intervene with targeted guidance and proactive outreach. Customers also reduce support ticket volumes by 15% on average while discovering upsell opportunities hidden in usage patterns.


Improve operational efficiency: For internal applications, drive faster employee onboarding, increase utilization of enterprise tools you've already purchased, and reduce training costs by embedding guidance directly in your applications.


The combination of analytics, guidance, and AI prediction means you're not just measuring problems—you're systematically fixing them while proving ROI to stakeholders.

+−

No. Pendo is designed for product, revenue, and IT teams to work independently—with powerful capabilities that can scale to meet enterprise data science and engineering needs when you have them.


Non-technical teams can create segments, build in-app guides, analyze user journeys, and deploy feedback surveys without writing code. Our AI guide builder and visual designer make it simple to launch experiences in minutes. At the same time, Pendo provides API access, data pipeline integrations, custom SQL queries, and advanced analytics for technical teams who want deeper control.


This "progressive disclosure" approach means your organization can get value immediately while growing sophistication over time. Product teams move fast without tickets to engineering, while IT and data teams have the security, governance, and integration capabilities they require.

+−

Pendo grows with you. Start by understanding adoption and guiding users in a single product, then expand to track engagement across your entire portfolio—whether that's multiple customer-facing SaaS products, internal applications like Salesforce, or conversational AI agents.


Organizations use Pendo to manage complex multi-product ecosystems: track cross-product journeys, identify which applications and agents drive the most value, optimize your SaaS spending by measuring actual utilization against licenses, and create consistent experiences across disparate systems. You can deploy Pendo on web, mobile, and AI applications with the same unified analytics and guidance capabilities.


The platform supports role-based access, SSO/SAML, data governance controls, and integration with your existing tech stack (CRM, data warehouse, support systems)—so it works for both a single product team and an enterprise IT organization managing dozens of applications.

Product teams move fast without tickets to engineering, while IT and data teams have the security, governance, and integration capabilities they require. + − How does Pendo scale from our first product to an entire digital portfolio? Organizations use Pendo to manage complex multi-product ecosystems: track cross-product journeys, identify which applications and agents drive the most value, optimize your SaaS spending by measuring actual utilization against licenses, and create consistent experiences across disparate systems. mainEntity.name: What makes Pendo different from other product experience platforms?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Pendo is the only platform that unifies product and agent analytics, user feedback, in-app guidance, and AI-powered predictions into a single source of truth for product experience. While other tools force you to stitch together multiple vendors—one for analytics, another for guides, a third for roadmapping—Pendo closes the loop: understand user behavior, capture sentiment, prioritize what to build, and drive adoption with targeted experiences, all from one platform.


This integrated approach means faster time-to-insight, better cross-functional alignment, and the ability to act on data without switching contexts. Organizations see faster ROI compared to alternatives, with implementations measured in weeks rather than quarters—whether you're a 50-person startup or a Fortune 500 enterprise with thousands of applications.

mainEntity.name: What business outcomes can we expect from Pendo?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The most impactful outcomes depend on your strategic priorities:


Accelerate product-led growth: Companies using Pendo improve trial-to-paid conversion rates by 25-40% by guiding users to activation moments faster. Reduce time-to-value for new customers, increase feature adoption, and turn your product into your best sales channel.


Reduce churn and expand revenue: Identify at-risk accounts 3-6 months before renewal using Pendo Predict's AI models, then intervene with targeted guidance and proactive outreach. Customers also reduce support ticket volumes by 15% on average while discovering upsell opportunities hidden in usage patterns.


Improve operational efficiency: For internal applications, drive faster employee onboarding, increase utilization of enterprise tools you've already purchased, and reduce training costs by embedding guidance directly in your applications.


The combination of analytics, guidance, and AI prediction means you're not just measuring problems—you're systematically fixing them while proving ROI to stakeholders.

mainEntity.name: Do we need a data science team or developers to use Pendo effectively?

acceptedAnswer.text:
No. Pendo is designed for product, revenue, and IT teams to work independently—with powerful capabilities that can scale to meet enterprise data science and engineering needs when you have them.


Non-technical teams can create segments, build in-app guides, analyze user journeys, and deploy feedback surveys without writing code. Our AI guide builder and visual designer make it simple to launch experiences in minutes. At the same time, Pendo provides API access, data pipeline integrations, custom SQL queries, and advanced analytics for technical teams who want deeper control.


This "progressive disclosure" approach means your organization can get value immediately while growing sophistication over time. Product teams move fast without tickets to engineering, while IT and data teams have the security, governance, and integration capabilities they require.

mainEntity.name: How does Pendo scale from our first product to an entire digital portfolio?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Pendo grows with you. Start by understanding adoption and guiding users in a single product, then expand to track engagement across your entire portfolio—whether that's multiple customer-facing SaaS products, internal applications like Salesforce, or conversational AI agents.


Organizations use Pendo to manage complex multi-product ecosystems: track cross-product journeys, identify which applications and agents drive the most value, optimize your SaaS spending by measuring actual utilization against licenses, and create consistent experiences across disparate systems. You can deploy Pendo on web, mobile, and AI applications with the same unified analytics and guidance capabilities.


The platform supports role-based access, SSO/SAML, data governance controls, and integration with your existing tech stack (CRM, data warehouse, support systems)—so it works for both a single product team and an enterprise IT organization managing dozens of applications.

About ClearCo

ClearCo is a revenue-based financing company helping ecommerce and SaaS businesses grow with non-dilutive capital and financial intelligence tools.

Learn More →
ChallengeProcessOutcomes
The Challenge

Moving upmarket meant shifting smaller clients to self-service—fast. The risk: if there was a noticeable drop in support quality, customers would feel it.

As ClearCo expanded its reach into enterprise accounts, it became clear their service model needed to evolve. Supporting every customer the same way was no longer sustainable—and it wasn't what customers wanted, either.

01

Moving upmarket changed the model

As ClearCo grew into enterprise accounts, SMB and mid-sized clients needed a different kind of support—one that didn't require the same level of hands-on CSM engagement.

02

Self-service carried real risk

Shifting customers to self-service without the right experience in place risked a drop in support quality. If customers felt that drop, they'd leave.

In Mindy's words
“Our organization is really committed to making data-driven decisions, and Pendo has become like a critical enabler of that.”

Mindy Hopkins, Product Education Manager at ClearCo

The Solution

How ClearCo built a personalized, scalable self-service experience with Pendo

Contents

Step 1 of 5

20%

01

Shifting to a self-service model without sacrificing quality

ClearCo made a strategic decision: shift small and mid-sized customers to a self-service model, while focusing customer success resources on larger, enterprise accounts.

But there was a catch. The team needed to ensure customers could still get fast, effective support—without increasing friction or impacting satisfaction.

The answer wasn't adding more resources. It was rethinking the experience entirely.

“We know across the board, customers prefer to get their answers quicker through self-service offerings. We really wanted to lean into that and help clients where they are, when they need it.”

Sam Martin, Head of Product Education at ClearCo
02

Building personalized, in-app support at scale

The team started by going straight to the source: their own customer-facing teams.

Using those insights, ClearCo built a tailored, in-app experience designed to guide users through key workflows—without needing to contact support.

“We coordinated closely with the customer success team to get a sense of the tasks they actually walk clients through. Especially the things customers focus on after implementation when they're really getting the hang of the product.”

Mindy Hopkins, Product Education Manager at ClearCo
01

Branching walkthroughs

Created personalized onboarding guides that adapt to each user's role and stage in their journey.

02

Embedded videos & automated messages

Used embedded video and targeted in-app messages to guide users through core tasks at the right moment.

03

Journeys via Pendo Orchestrate

Leveraged Pendo Orchestrate to deliver timely, stage-based onboarding communications at scale.

04

Centralized resource center

Directed users to a resource center with dynamic permalinks for instant, step-by-step help—without a support ticket.

03

Creating a continuous improvement loop

What set ClearCo's approach apart wasn't just the experience—it was how tightly it connected to their product strategy.

Pendo became more than a support tool. It became a system for understanding, guiding, and improving the customer journey end to end. The team used in-app data to inform product decisions, then delivered guidance to support users in the moment, then fed that data back into their product strategy.

“We use the user data to inform product decisions, then deliver the in-app guidance to support users in that moment, and then feed that data back into our product strategy. So it kind of creates a continuous improvement loop.”

Sam Martin, Head of Product Education at ClearCo
04

Unlocking scale without compromise

For many organizations, scaling support means tradeoffs. But for ClearCo, Pendo made it possible to do both.

By embedding guidance directly into the product, the team empowered customers to find answers instantly—without needing to submit a ticket or wait for help. Internally, it freed up teams to focus on higher-value work. The CS team could be strategic and focus on consulting with clients rather than answering repetitive questions.

“Pendo has allowed us to scale while also making sure that our service is top notch, which is a really delicate balance.”

Sam Martin, Head of Product Education at ClearCo
05

A platform for innovation—not just support

As ClearCo continues to evolve, Pendo remains central to how they innovate and engage users. That flexibility has allowed the team to get creative with how they deliver value in the product—from embedded guides that highlight new features to automated workflows that help users move faster.

“It's surprisingly intuitive. And it has evolved so much faster than any of the other products that I use. Pendo is genuinely ahead of the curve, especially with AI and automations.”

Mindy Hopkins, Product Education Manager at ClearCo
The Outcome

Scale without compromise.

ClearCo reduced churn, lowered costs, and protected the customer experience—all at the same time.

0+

Accounts transitioned to fully self-service

Over 1,100 SMB accounts moved to a completely self-service model—without a single point of CSAT decline.

0%

Reduction in account cancellations

By proactively supporting customers through personalized in-app guidance, ClearCo nearly halved their cancellation rate.

0%

Drop in call volume

With a comprehensive resource center and embedded walkthroughs, customers found answers on their own—without picking up the phone.

0%

CSAT maintained with no decline

Despite transitioning 1,100+ accounts to self-service, customer satisfaction held steady at 91%—proof that self-service done right feels like better support.

“Pendo has really become a lever for us to pull that puts user experience in the driver seat. It gives us low-code ways to engage with our users right in the platform and then gather insights about those interactions. All in one.”

Mindy Hopkins

Product Education Manager at ClearCo

Ready to scale support without sacrificing quality?

For growing SaaS companies, the question isn't whether to move toward self-service—it's how to do it without losing customers along the way.

The right in-app experience makes all the difference. Start by understanding where customers drop off, what questions they're asking, and which tasks they need the most help completing on their own.

In Mindy's words “ Our organization is really committed to making data-driven decisions, and Pendo has become like a critical enabler of that. ” Mindy Hopkins, Product Education Manager at ClearCo The Solution How ClearCo built a personalized, scalable self-service experience with Pendo Contents 01 Shifting to a self-service model witho… 02 Building personalized, in-app support … 03 Creating a continuous improvement loop 04 Unlocking scale without compromise 05 A platform for innovation—not just sup… Step 1 of 5 20 % 01 Shifting to a self-service model without sacrificing quality ClearCo made a strategic decision: shift small and mid-sized customers to a self-service model, while focusing customer success resources on larger, enterprise accounts. But there was a catch. The team needed to ensure customers could still get fast, effective support—without increasing friction or impacting satisfaction. The answer wasn't adding more resources. It was rethinking the experience entirely. “ We know across the board, customers prefer to get their answers quicker through self-service offerings. We really wanted to lean into that and help clients where they are, when they need it. ” Sam Martin, Head of Product Education at ClearCo 02 Building personalized, in-app support at scale The team started by going straight to the source: their own customer-facing teams. Using those insights, ClearCo built a tailored, in-app experience designed to guide users through key workflows—without needing to contact support. “ We coordinated closely with the customer success team to get a sense of the tasks they actually walk clients through. Especially the things customers focus on after implementation when they're really getting the hang of the product. ” Mindy Hopkins, Product Education Manager at ClearCo 01 Branching walkthroughs Created personalized onboarding guides that adapt to each user's role and stage in their journey. 02 Embedded videos & automated messages Used embedded video and targeted in-app messages to guide users through core tasks at the right moment. 03 Journeys via Pendo Orchestrate Leveraged Pendo Orchestrate to deliver timely, stage-based onboarding communications at scale. 04 Centralized resource center Directed users to a resource center with dynamic permalinks for instant, step-by-step help—without a support ticket. 03 Creating a continuous improvement loop What set ClearCo's approach apart wasn't just the experience—it was how tightly it connected to their product strategy. Pendo became more than a support tool. It became a system for understanding, guiding, and improving the customer journey end to end. The team used in-app data to inform product decisions, then delivered guidance to support users in the moment, then fed that data back into their product strategy. “ We use the user data to inform product decisions, then deliver the in-app guidance to support users in that moment, and then feed that data back into our product strategy. So it kind of creates a continuous improvement loop. ” Sam Martin, Head of Product Education at ClearCo 04 Unlocking scale without compromise For many organizations, scaling support means tradeoffs. But for ClearCo, Pendo made it possible to do both. By embedding guidance directly into the product, the team empowered customers to find answers instantly—without needing to submit a ticket or wait for help. Internally, it freed up teams to focus on higher-value work. The CS team could be strategic and focus on consulting with clients rather than answering repetitive questions. “ Pendo has allowed us to scale while also making sure that our service is top notch, which is a really delicate balance. ” Sam Martin, Head of Product Education at ClearCo 05 A platform for innovation—not just support As ClearCo continues to evolve, Pendo remains central to how they innovate and engage users. That flexibility has allowed the team to get creative with how they deliver value in the product—from embedded guides that highlight new features to automated workflows that help users move faster. “ It's surprisingly intuitive. And it has evolved so much faster than any of the other products that I use. Pendo is genuinely ahead of the curve, especially with AI and automations. ” Mindy Hopkins, Product Education Manager at ClearCo The Outcome Scale without compromise. ClearCo reduced churn, lowered costs, and protected the customer experience—all at the same time. 0 + Accounts transitioned to fully self-service Over 1,100 SMB accounts moved to a completely self-service model—without a single point of CSAT decline. 0 % Reduction in account cancellations By proactively supporting customers through personalized in-app guidance, ClearCo nearly halved their cancellation rate. 0 % Drop in call volume With a comprehensive resource center and embedded walkthroughs, customers found answers on their own—without picking up the phone. 0 % CSAT maintained with no decline Despite transitioning 1,100+ accounts to self-service, customer satisfaction held steady at 91%—proof that self-service done right feels like better support. “ Pendo has really become a lever for us to pull that puts user experience in the driver seat. It gives us low-code ways to engage with our users right in the platform and then gather insights about those interactions. All in one. ” Mindy Hopkins Product Education Manager at ClearCo Ready to scale support without sacrificing quality? For growing SaaS companies, the question isn't whether to move toward self-service—it's how to do it without losing customers along the way. The right in-app experience makes all the difference. Start by understanding where customers drop off, what questions they're asking, and which tasks they need the most help completing on their own. Pendo Pricing FAQ

+−

Pendo pricing combines two things: the number of Monthly Active Users (MAUs) you track and the functionality you choose as part of your plan. As you add more MAUs, your overall price increases, but the cost per MAU goes down.

This model makes it simple to start small and expand as your needs grow. You only pay for the scale and functionality that create value for your business, and you can add more at any time. Our focus is helping you grow adoption and realize greater value from Pendo, so our priorities remain directly tied to the outcomes that matter most to you.

+−

Monthly active users (MAUs) are the number of unique visitors who were active in your app over the last 30 calendar days. In general, a unique visitor is counted as an active user if they engage with your app(s) at least once within a specified time period.

+−

No. Pendo pricing is based on Monthly Active Users (MAUs), not the number of applications you track or the number of sessions a user has. You can use Pendo across multiple applications at no additional cost per application. In fact, adding more applications gives you richer insights and a more complete view of your users.

+−

Volume and bundle discounts are already built into our pricing. We can also tailor additional options to your specific business needs. Your Pendo representative can guide you through the best fit.

+−

Yes. Because Pendo is an extensive solution, we recommend starting with the areas most relevant to your goals, then expanding from there. Talk to sales to get started with a Pendo trial.

Looking for a free product to try today? Check out Novus, Pendo's AI-native free product for teams shipping with AI. Learn about Novus

If you’re already a customer and want to try additional functionality, reach out. We’re happy to set up trial access so you can explore new features when the timing is right for your team.

+−

Pendo Free is our free-forever version that helps teams get started with improving their software experience. It includes product analytics, in-app guides, Pendo-branded roadmaps, and Pendo-branded NPS surveys, and supports unlimited web and mobile app keys for up to 500 monthly active users (MAUs). It’s a great way to explore core functionality and see the power of Pendo in action.

The 30-day free trial gives you access to the entire platform – analytics, in-app guides, feedback, journey orchestration, and more – so you can experience everything before choosing the plan that fits your needs. If you want the full picture of what Pendo can do, the trial is the best place to start.

+−

Our bundles are designed to deliver the most value by combining capabilities that work best together. That said, we know every business is different and plans can be customized based on your business needs. Talk to a rep for more information.

+−

Pendo connects with more than 85 tools across CRM, support, marketing automation, collaboration, and analytics platforms. For the complete list, visit the Pendo integrations page.

+−

If you’re on a paid plan, exceeding your MAU limit won’t disrupt your Pendo experience. Your functionality will continue to run without interruption. Your Pendo account representative will reach out to understand whether the increase is due to expected growth that may require a contract adjustment, or if it’s a configuration issue we can help resolve.

If you’re on Pendo Free, exceeding the MAU limit means you won’t be able to create new guides, NPS surveys, or segments until you upgrade to a paid plan.

No pressure. Just answers.

See how Pendo works for your specific challenges, whether you’re tracking adoption, proving ROI, or measuring AI.

does Pendo pricing work?","answer":"

Pendo pricing combines two things: the number of Monthly Active Users (MAUs) you track and the functionality you choose as part of your plan. As you add more MAUs, your overall price increases, but the cost per MAU goes down.

This model makes it simple to start small and expand as your needs grow. You only pay for the scale and functionality that create value for your business, and you can add more at any time. Our focus is helping you grow adoption and realize greater value from Pendo, so our priorities remain directly tied to the outcomes that matter most to you.

"},{"question":"What is a Monthly Active User in Pendo?","answer":"

Monthly active users (MAUs) are the number of unique visitors who were active in your app over the last 30 calendar days. In general, a unique visitor is counted as an active user if they engage with your app(s) at least once within a specified time period.

"},{"question":"Does the number of applications I have, or the number of sessions I have affect my pricing with Pendo?","answer":"

No. Pendo pricing is based on Monthly Active Users (MAUs), not the number of applications you track or the number of sessions a user has. You can use Pendo across multiple applications at no additional cost per application. In fact, adding more applications gives you richer insights and a more complete view of your users.

"},{"question":"Does Pendo offer discounts?","answer":"

Volume and bundle discounts are already built into our pricing. We can also tailor additional options to your specific business needs. Your Pendo representative can guide you through the best fit.

"},{"question":"Does Pendo offer a free trial? ","answer":"

Yes. Because Pendo is an extensive solution, we recommend starting with the areas most relevant to your goals, then expanding from there. Talk to sales to get started with a Pendo trial.

Looking for a free product to try today? Check out Novus, Pendo's AI-native free product for teams shipping with AI. Learn about Novus

If you’re already a customer and want to try additional functionality, reach out. We’re happy to set up trial access so you can explore new features when the timing is right for your team.

"},{"question":"How is the Pendo free trial different from Pendo Free, and how do I choose?","answer":"

Pendo Free is our free-forever version that helps teams get started with improving their software experience. It includes product analytics, in-app guides, Pendo-branded roadmaps, and Pendo-branded NPS surveys, and supports unlimited web and mobile app keys for up to 500 monthly active users (MAUs). It’s a great way to explore core functionality and see the power of Pendo in action.

The 30-day free trial gives you access to the entire platform – analytics, in-app guides, feedback, journey orchestration, and more – so you can experience everything before choosing the plan that fits your needs. If you want the full picture of what Pendo can do, the trial is the best place to start.

"},{"question":"Can I customize a Pendo plan?","answer":"

Our bundles are designed to deliver the most value by combining capabilities that work best together. That said, we know every business is different and plans can be customized based on your business needs. Talk to a rep for more information.

"},{"question":"What integrations does Pendo support?","answer":"

Pendo connects with more than 85 tools across CRM, support, marketing automation, collaboration, and analytics platforms. For the complete list, visit the Pendo integrations page.

"},{"question":"What happens if I exceed my Pendo plan limits?","answer":"

If you’re on a paid plan, exceeding your MAU limit won’t disrupt your Pendo experience. Your functionality will continue to run without interruption. Your Pendo account representative will reach out to understand whether the increase is due to expected growth that may require a contract adjustment, or if it’s a configuration issue we can help resolve.

If you’re on Pendo Free, exceeding the MAU limit means you won’t be able to create new guides, NPS surveys, or segments until you upgrade to a paid plan.

Pendo can be a powerful tool—or just another line item in your tech stack.


Maybe you were the one who championed it and now you’re trying to get everyone else on board. Or maybe it landed in your lap and you’re wondering where to start.


Either way, the challenge is the same: how do you turn Pendo into something that actually drives adoption and business impact?


In this session, Liz will share how blending customer experience principles, product-led growth strategies, and yes—even classic improv—can help you organize your Pendo efforts, align them with real business goals, and shift mindsets across your organization.


Let's get some actionable steps to move from “just using Pendo” to making it a strategic advantage.

Shipping is now the easy part. Deciding what’s worth shipping is the real challenge. As AI makes the cost of building and deploying code cheaper than ever, the primary risk has shifted from \"can we build it?\" to \"should we?\"


In this session, Chelsea Bullock, Sr. Principal Product Manager at Atlassian, shares how her team masters this trade-off while partnering with high-stakes enterprise customers — environments where speed is a requirement, but mistakes are devastatingly expensive.


You’ll see how they:

  • Test assumptions before scaling them into production.
  • Eliminate work that looks good on a screen but fails to move the needle.
  • Keep product, design, and engineering synchronized as the volume of output accelerates.


Forget process theater. If you lead product in a complex, high-stakes organization, this is a clear look at how to reduce the noise of infinite production, make better bets, and build only what truly matters.

IQVIA didn't start thinking about AI agents yesterday. They started by getting the fundamentals right: building a COE, standardizing how teams use product experience tools, creating the operational muscle to scale digital experiences across a global, regulated enterprise.


Now, that foundation is being put to the test. As the company moves toward AI-first product experiences, the teams responsible for governance and design are asking new questions: What happens when experiences aren't scripted? How do you govern outputs you can't fully control? And how do you bring a regulated industry along for the ride?


Holiday Eng will explore the operational model that's worked and where it's starting to strain. Jordan Morris will explore what's changing in UX when agents enter the picture. Together, they'll reflect on what holds, what breaks, and what they're still figuring out. If your organization is somewhere on this same journey, this session is for you.

Users tell us where resilience lives: not in security stacks or dashboards, but in their behaviors. Trellix has moving beyond surface analytics and track the signals that actually predict adoption, trust, and risk.


Whether it’s minimizing clicks, double-checking raw data, resisting change, demanding context, or questioning AI’s transparency, these aren’t edge cases. They’re leading indicators.

In this talk, GitHub product operations leader Chris Butler uses design fiction to imagine a near future where AI agents work alongside engineers, designers, product managers, customer support, legal, privacy, and security — raising uncomfortable but necessary questions about decision-making, trust, and accountability when not everyone in the room is human.

SMART Goals and OKRs are so deeply ingrained in corporate culture, they're taken as gospel—we don't question whether goal-setting actually works.

You’ll learn to recognize patterns of how targets and OKRs can stifle curiosity, incentivize gaming the numbers, and distract teams from solving the right problems. But without OKRs, will you and your team be as ambitious, aligned, and motivated? Spoiler alert: Yes, yes, and yes! 

Through real-world examples, you'll see how shifting to a mindset of puzzle-setting and puzzle-solving drives far better business outcomes. You'll learn about a powerful framework to help you put this into practice so you can encourage experimentation, measure what matters, and make meaningful progress.

Pendo pricing combines two things: the number of Monthly Active Users (MAUs) you track and the functionality you choose as part of your plan. As you add more MAUs, your overall price increases, but the cost per MAU goes down. This model makes it simple to start small and expand as your needs grow. You only pay for the scale and functionality that create value for your business, and you can add more at any time. Our focus is helping you grow adoption and realize greater value from Pendo, so our priorities remain directly tied to the outcomes that matter most to you. + − What is a Monthly Active User in Pendo? Monthly active users (MAUs) are the number of unique visitors who were active in your app over the last 30 calendar days. In general, a unique visitor is counted as an active user if they engage with your app(s) at least once within a specified time period. + − Does the number of applications I have, or the number of sessions I have affect my pricing with Pendo? No. Pendo pricing is based on Monthly Active Users (MAUs), not the number of applications you track or the number of sessions a user has. You can use Pendo across multiple applications at no additional cost per application. In fact, adding more applications gives you richer insights and a more complete view of your users. + − Does Pendo offer discounts? Volume and bundle discounts are already built into our pricing. We can also tailor additional options to your specific business needs. Your Pendo representative can guide you through the best fit. + − Does Pendo offer a free trial? Yes. Because Pendo is an extensive solution, we recommend starting with the areas most relevant to your goals, then expanding from there. Talk to sales to get started with a Pendo trial. Looking for a free product to try today? Check out Novus , Pendo's AI-native free product for teams shipping with AI. Learn about Novus If you’re already a customer and want to try additional functionality, reach out. We’re happy to set up trial access so you can explore new features when the timing is right for your team. + − How is the Pendo free trial different from Pendo Free, and how do I choose? Pendo Free is our free-forever version that helps teams get started with improving their software experience. It includes product analytics, in-app guides, Pendo-branded roadmaps, and Pendo-branded NPS surveys, and supports unlimited web and mobile app keys for up to 500 monthly active users (MAUs). It’s a great way to explore core functionality and see the power of Pendo in action. The 30-day free trial gives you access to the entire platform – analytics, in-app guides, feedback, journey orchestration, and more – so you can experience everything before choosing the plan that fits your needs. If you want the full picture of what Pendo can do, the trial is the best place to start. + − Can I customize a Pendo plan? Our bundles are designed to deliver the most value by combining capabilities that work best together. That said, we know every business is different and plans can be customized based on your business needs. Talk to a rep for more information. + − What integrations does Pendo support? Pendo connects with more than 85 tools across CRM, support, marketing automation, collaboration, and analytics platforms. For the complete list, visit the Pendo integrations page . + − What happens if I exceed my Pendo plan limits? If you’re on a paid plan, exceeding your MAU limit won’t disrupt your Pendo experience. Your functionality will continue to run without interruption. Your Pendo account representative will reach out to understand whether the increase is due to expected growth that may require a contract adjustment, or if it’s a configuration issue we can help resolve. If you’re on Pendo Free, exceeding the MAU limit means you won’t be able to create new guides, NPS surveys, or segments until you upgrade to a paid plan. No pressure. Just answers. acceptedAnswer.text:
Pendo pricing combines two things: the number of Monthly Active Users (MAUs) you track and the functionality you choose as part of your plan. As you add more MAUs, your overall price increases, but the cost per MAU goes down.

This model makes it simple to start small and expand as your needs grow. You only pay for the scale and functionality that create value for your business, and you can add more at any time. Our focus is helping you grow adoption and realize greater value from Pendo, so our priorities remain directly tied to the outcomes that matter most to you.

mainEntity.name: What is a Monthly Active User in Pendo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monthly active users (MAUs) are the number of unique visitors who were active in your app over the last 30 calendar days. In general, a unique visitor is counted as an active user if they engage with your app(s) at least once within a specified time period.

mainEntity.name: Does the number of applications I have, or the number of sessions I have affect my pricing with Pendo?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Pendo pricing is based on Monthly Active Users (MAUs), not the number of applications you track or the number of sessions a user has. You can use Pendo across multiple applications at no additional cost per application. In fact, adding more applications gives you richer insights and a more complete view of your users.
Volume and bundle discounts are already built into our pricing. We can also tailor additional options to your specific business needs. Your Pendo representative can guide you through the best fit.

mainEntity.name: Does Pendo offer a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. Because Pendo is an extensive solution, we recommend starting with the areas most relevant to your goals, then expanding from there. Talk to sales to get started with a Pendo trial.

Looking for a free product to try today? Check out Novus, Pendo's AI-native free product for teams shipping with AI. Learn about Novus

If you’re already a customer and want to try additional functionality, reach out. We’re happy to set up trial access so you can explore new features when the timing is right for your team.

mainEntity.name: How is the Pendo free trial different from Pendo Free, and how do I choose?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Pendo Free is our free-forever version that helps teams get started with improving their software experience. It includes product analytics, in-app guides, Pendo-branded roadmaps, and Pendo-branded NPS surveys, and supports unlimited web and mobile app keys for up to 500 monthly active users (MAUs). It’s a great way to explore core functionality and see the power of Pendo in action.

The 30-day free trial gives you access to the entire platform – analytics, in-app guides, feedback, journey orchestration, and more – so you can experience everything before choosing the plan that fits your needs. If you want the full picture of what Pendo can do, the trial is the best place to start.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize a Pendo plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our bundles are designed to deliver the most value by combining capabilities that work best together. That said, we know every business is different and plans can be customized based on your business needs. Talk to a rep for more information.
Pendo connects with more than 85 tools across CRM, support, marketing automation, collaboration, and analytics platforms. For the complete list, visit the Pendo integrations page.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I exceed my Pendo plan limits?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If you’re on a paid plan, exceeding your MAU limit won’t disrupt your Pendo experience. Your functionality will continue to run without interruption. Your Pendo account representative will reach out to understand whether the increase is due to expected growth that may require a contract adjustment, or if it’s a configuration issue we can help resolve.

If you’re on Pendo Free, exceeding the MAU limit means you won’t be able to create new guides, NPS surveys, or segments until you upgrade to a paid plan.

Maybe you were the one who championed it and now you’re trying to get everyone else on board. Or maybe it landed in your lap and you’re wondering where to start.

Most product teams building AI agents focus on getting them to work, but once they go live, new questions emerge fast. Which agent accessed what data, whose credentials did it use, and how do you prevent one user's agent from accessing another user's sensitive information?


This session walks through the security and governance challenges that surface when you ship customer-facing AI agents. Drawing from his experience as the CTO of Merge, Gil Feig will address credential management across multiple users, audit trails that actually work, and preventing data access misconfigurations before they become incidents.

Shipping is now the easy part. Deciding what’s worth shipping is the real challenge. As AI makes the cost of building and deploying code cheaper than ever, the primary risk has shifted from \"can we build it?\" to \"should we?\"


In this session, Chelsea Bullock, Sr. Principal Product Manager at Atlassian, shares how her team masters this trade-off while partnering with high-stakes enterprise customers — environments where speed is a requirement, but mistakes are devastatingly expensive.


You’ll see how they:

  • Test assumptions before scaling them into production.
  • Eliminate work that looks good on a screen but fails to move the needle.
  • Keep product, design, and engineering synchronized as the volume of output accelerates.


Forget process theater. If you lead product in a complex, high-stakes organization, this is a clear look at how to reduce the noise of infinite production, make better bets, and build only what truly matters.

IQVIA didn't start thinking about AI agents yesterday. They started by getting the fundamentals right: building a COE, standardizing how teams use product experience tools, creating the operational muscle to scale digital experiences across a global, regulated enterprise.


Now, that foundation is being put to the test. As the company moves toward AI-first product experiences, the teams responsible for governance and design are asking new questions: What happens when experiences aren't scripted? How do you govern outputs you can't fully control? And how do you bring a regulated industry along for the ride?


Holiday Eng will explore the operational model that's worked and where it's starting to strain. Jordan Morris will explore what's changing in UX when agents enter the picture. Together, they'll reflect on what holds, what breaks, and what they're still figuring out. If your organization is somewhere on this same journey, this session is for you.

Users tell us where resilience lives: not in security stacks or dashboards, but in their behaviors. Trellix has moving beyond surface analytics and track the signals that actually predict adoption, trust, and risk.


Whether it’s minimizing clicks, double-checking raw data, resisting change, demanding context, or questioning AI’s transparency, these aren’t edge cases. They’re leading indicators.


This session shows how Trellix measured these signals, translated them into North Star metrics, and push product and UX decisions that hardened both user trust and business outcomes. Because in cybersecurity (and in every product space), human behavior is the sharpest signal of resilience.

As AI agents move from tools to active participants, product teams will need to rethink how collaboration actually works.


In this talk, GitHub product operations leader Chris Butler uses design fiction to imagine a near future where AI agents work alongside engineers, designers, product managers, customer support, legal, privacy, and security — raising uncomfortable but necessary questions about decision-making, trust, and accountability when not everyone in the room is human.


When should teams listen to an agent, when should they ignore it, and what does alignment really mean in a world of partially automated contributors? This session helps product leaders start grappling with those questions before that future arrives.

SMART Goals and OKRs are so deeply ingrained in corporate culture, they're taken as gospel—we don't question whether goal-setting actually works.

You’ll learn to recognize patterns of how targets and OKRs can stifle curiosity, incentivize gaming the numbers, and distract teams from solving the right problems. But without OKRs, will you and your team be as ambitious, aligned, and motivated? Spoiler alert: Yes, yes, and yes! 

Through real-world examples, you'll see how shifting to a mindset of puzzle-setting and puzzle-solving drives far better business outcomes. You'll learn about a powerful framework to help you put this into practice so you can encourage experimentation, measure what matters, and make meaningful progress.

Product sense is one of the most talked-about—and least clearly defined—skills in product management. Is it instinct or rigor? Taste or technique? Can it be taught, or is it something you’re simply born with?

In this talk, Vrushali Paunikar, CPO of Carta, breaks down product sense into its core building blocks and shares how her teams turned an elusive concept into a repeatable discipline. She’ll explore how great product judgment is formed, how organizations can systematically level up product sense, and how AI is changing the way we learn, test, and scale product intuition—without losing taste.
